sections.heading: 1. Warm it, then move it
lines: ① Warm shower or heat pack, 10–15 min.
② Turn and look up/down within comfort, 5 each.
③ Shoulder rolls, 10 reps, every hour.
④ Under a vent? Add a light layer.

caption:
Mr Turtle sat under the air-con all day and now his neck won't turn. There isn't strong evidence that a cold draught alone causes it. Feeling chilly does make you hunch and hold still, though.

Add a long day without moving, an awkward sleep or a stressful week, and the neck can feel locked. Warmth from a shower or heat pack, gentle movement every hour and a light layer under the vent often help. Most stiff necks settle within a few days to a week.

A stiff neck with fever, headache or feeling unwell needs a doctor the same day. Arm symptoms, dizziness or no change after a week are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio.
